typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style Subtitle.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style Subtitle.

recognitionRules: Place Working agreement and version beneath the title.
Use clear Calibri headings and compact acceptance tables.
Separate what each person provides from what the joint result must contain.
Keep changes recorded as dated decisions rather than invisible wording revisions.

principles: Name the choice, its owner and the condition that makes it complete.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Agree on the work before the work begins.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid certainty about forecasts, capacity or commitments that are still provisional.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: This is the assumption; this is the decision it affects.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use SHARED SCOPE in Calibri with two short rules meeting at one baseline. Keep it typographic, not a partnership handshake symbol.
invariants: Place Working agreement and version beneath the title.
Use clear Calibri headings and compact acceptance tables.
Separate what each person provides from what the joint result must contain.
adaptations: A small collaboration can use one page with roles, output and checks.
Preserve the version line in every export.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Calibri is a separately licensed Microsoft/Office font; not bundled.
Calibri is a separately licensed Microsoft/Office font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
